primary_detection_prompt: small frosted glass probiotic drink bottle with black ribbed cap and large black angular Z logo
alternate_prompts: small clear glass bottle with black screw cap
small probiotic shot bottle with black Z logo
mini wellness drink bottle with black cap and white liquid
15 mL frosted glass vial with large black Z-shaped logo

visual_attributes.shape: short narrow cylindrical glass bottle with rounded shoulders and short transparent neck
visual_attributes.cap: black ribbed plastic screw cap, wider than the neck, flat top
visual_attributes.body: clear or frosted transparent glass bottle filled with cloudy off-white liquid
visual_attributes.label: minimal front label with large bold black angular Z-shaped logo
visual_attributes.text: small vertical orange text on the left side reading pre-alcohol probiotic drink; small vertical black volume text near the right edge
visual_attributes.scale: very small bottle, approximately shot-sized or vial-sized

hard_negative_objects: generic glass vial without black Z logo
black-capped bottle without large black Z logo
most_important_matching_features: large black angular Z logo on the front
